description: Generate fake test data (CSV, JSON or SQL INSERTs) from a table schema. Use it first, when you need rows for fixtures, seed data or tests (list_column_types gives each type's options). Or pass schema (JSON Schema, e.g. a Pydantic or Zod export, or an OpenAPI component) instead of columns; unmappable fields are named. For related tables with matching keys, pass tables (one call, SQL or JSON). Next: invalid_values for values your code should reject. Free and rate-limited: up to 500 rows and 50 columns per call. No real person's data is used as input and no record is derived from a real person; emails, phones, card numbers, SSN-shaped and IBAN-shaped values come only from reserved or invalid ranges. The same schema and seed give byte-identical output for the same generator version (sent as x-generator-version). For more than about 50 rows, pass output_path to write a file instead of returning the data. The result gives the output's sha256 and ends with a curl that regenerates the same bytes. Send schemas only, never real data.

chaos.description: Deliberate misbehaviour for testing error handling

name.description: Column name: lowercase letters, digits and _

type.description: One of: uuid, sequence (start, step, prefix, pad), integer (min, max), decimal (min, max, scale), boolean (p_true), enum (values, weights), date (from, to: YYYY-MM-DD), datetime (from, to), first_name, last_name, full_name, email, phone, test_card, ssn_invalid, iban_invalid, text (min_words, max_words). Every column also takes null_rate.

output_path.description: Write the data to this file instead of returning it (use for more than about 50 rows). Must be inside the working directory, or inside ROWSMITH_OUT_DIR when set; no '..' segments

overwrite.description: Replace output_path if it already exists (default false)

schema.description: Instead of columns: a JSON Schema object, or {openapi: <document>, component: <name>}

seed.description: Seed; the same schema and seed give identical output for the same generator version (default 1)

table.description: Table name, used in SQL output (default data)

tables.description: Instead of columns, schema, rows, table: related tables in order, each {name, rows, columns or schema}. A column {name, type: 'ref', table, column} takes its values from an earlier table's primary key (uuid or sequence named id). Format sql or json; 500 rows in total

name: generate_test_data
title: Generate test data
